snippet: ## Curated Drug-Drug Interactions Database  DDInter is a comprehensive, professional, and open-access database specific to drug-drug interactions. It provides abundant annotations for each DDI association including mechanism description, risk levels, management strategies, alternative medications, etc. to improve clinical decision-making and patient safety.
